title: cbuild_state
description: The answer of GET cbuild/v1/kits/<id>/state: the state of a build of a kit. Fields are added in minor versions and never renamed or removed within a major one.

step.description: The key of the slot whose options are listed: the one asked for, or the first with nothing picked.

ready.description: Whether the build may go to the cart.

texts.description: The kit's own texts, as the owner typed them or as a plugin answered the filter cbuild_kit_text.

lead_time.description: How long assembly takes, or an empty string.

returns_notice.description: What the shop says of returning an assembled build, or an empty string.

presets.description: The kit's ready builds, six at most.

description.description: A line on who it is for, or an empty string.

picks.description: A part for each slot it fills.

steps.description: The kit's slots, in step order.

help.description: The slot's help text, or an empty string.

required.description: Whether a build needs a part here.

units.description: How many units of the part a build takes.

picked.description: The ID of the part picked, or null.

recommended.description: The ID of the part the step starts on while nothing is picked, or null. The total counts it.

offered.description: How many parts the slot offers.

hidden.description: How many parts the slot hides because they do not fit.

groups.description: The hidden parts, counted by reason.

message.description: The count and the reason as a sentence.

options.description: The parts the current step offers: the first 24, those the shop can supply first, and the part the step counts.

hidden.description: The parts the current step hides, each with why: the first 24, and the pick when it is one of them.

refused.description: The picks sent that were not taken.

problems.description: What keeps the build from the cart. Empty when ready is true.

changes.description: What the last change does to the picks after it, when previous was sent and a later pick no longer fits; otherwise null.

kept.description: The keys of the slots whose picks stay.

proposed.description: The build if the shopper takes the changes: a pick per slot, in step order. A slot with no part that fits has none.

changes.description: The picks that no longer fit, in step order.

was.description: The ID of the part picked.

name.description: Its name, or an empty string when the product has gone.

closest.description: The closest part that fits and is in stock, or null when there is none.

total.description: What the build costs so far.

lines.description: A line per part the build counts, in step order.

name.description: The part's name, or an empty string when the product has gone.

quantity.description: How many of the part the build takes.

price.description: The part's own price for one.

charged.description: What one is charged at, with the build discount off.

saved.description: What the build discount takes off.

assembly.description: Whether the shop assembles the build.

fee.description: The assembly fee: nothing when assembly is off or free.

money.description: An amount in the shop's currency.

amount.description: The amount in whole minor units: cents, where the currency has two decimals.

text.description: The amount as the shop writes its prices, in plain text.

code.description: The finding's code, one of the message codes in docs/HOOKS.md.

severity.description: How bad: a note on a part that fits, a warning, or a block.

text.description: The finding as a sentence, in the language of the answer.

card.description: What a card shows of a part.

name.description: The part's name, in plain text.

url.description: The address of the part's own page.

price.description: The price of one as the shop shows it, in plain text.

stock.description: The shop's own words for the part's availability, in the shop's stock display format. Empty where the shop says nothing of a part in stock.

stock_class.description: WooCommerce's class for the availability: in-stock, out-of-stock or available-on-backorder.

image.description: The part's photo at the catalogue's size, or null when it has none.

option.description: A part as a slot holds it.

id.description: The part's ID: a product's or a variation's.

brand.description: The part's brand, or an empty string.

fit.description: How the part fits the picks before it: the worst of its messages.

in_stock.description: Whether the shop has the part.

available.description: Whether the shop has as many as a build takes.

quantity.description: How many of the part a build takes, or null when the part gives no set size.

picked.description: Whether it is the step's pick.

recommended.description: Whether it is the part the step starts on.

messages.description: What the rules found of it, notes included.

card.description: What its card shows, or null when the product has gone since the index read it.

problem.description: A pick not taken, or something that keeps the build from the cart.

code.description: The problem's code, one of the problem codes in docs/HOOKS.md.

slot.description: The slot's key, as sent where the kit has no such slot.

part.description: The part's ID, or null where there is none to name.

message.description: The problem as a sentence, in the language of the answer.

messages.description: For a part the rules block, what they found.
